AI / Agentic AI Engineer - Enterprise Observability

Overview

The Enterprise Observability team is responsible for monitoring, maintaining, and improving the health of critical banking applications, services, and infrastructure. As observability platforms generate massive volumes of metrics, events, logs, traces, and synthetic monitoring data, operational teams require intelligent solutions to identify, correlate, and remediate issues rapidly.

We are seeking an experienced AI / Agentic AI Engineer to design and develop next-generation AI-powered observability solutions that transform operational monitoring into proactive, intelligent, and increasingly autonomous systems.

This role will focus on building Agentic AI and RAG-based platforms capable of analyzing operational telemetry data, accelerating incident investigations, reducing alert fatigue, recommending corrective actions, and enabling self-healing capabilities across enterprise banking environments.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI Development

Design and develop enterprise-scale Agentic AI solutions for observability and operational workflows.
Build autonomous and semi-autonomous agents capable of incident investigation and remediation.
Implement multi-agent frameworks using LangGraph, LangChain, Microsoft AutoGen, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
Develop AI orchestration workflows that support operational decision-making.

RAG & Knowledge Engineering

Design Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures for operational intelligence.
Build and manage enterprise knowledge repositories and incident knowledge bases.
Develop solutions leveraging vector databases such as:
Azure AI Search
Pinecone
Weaviate
ChromaDB
Implement incident knowledge graphs and context-aware retrieval systems.

Observability & AIOps

Analyze Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces, and Synthetics (MELTS) data across multiple observability platforms.
Develop AI-driven root cause analysis and anomaly detection solutions.
Create intelligent alert correlation and incident prioritization mechanisms.
Enable proactive issue detection and predictive analytics capabilities.

Automation Engineering

Develop operational runbooks and automated remediation workflows.
Build self-healing automation solutions using:
Python
PowerShell
REST APIs
Workflow orchestration tools
Integrate AI systems with observability and IT operations platforms.
Drive improvements in operational efficiency and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with Observability, SRE, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, and Operations teams.
Translate business and operational requirements into AI-powered solutions.
Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on operational resilience and service reliability.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical Skills

Strong experience in Agentic AI solution development.
Expertise in LangChain, LangGraph, Microsoft AutoGen, Azure AI Foundry, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Experience with vector databases including Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Azure AI Search.
Strong programming skills in Python.

Automation & Integration

Experience building remediation workflows and operational automation solutions.
Hands-on experience with REST APIs and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of PowerShell and automation scripting.

Observability & Operations

Understanding of observability concepts including Metrics, Logs, Events, Traces, and Synthetic Monitoring.
Experience supporting AIOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, or Platform Engineering environments.
Knowledge of incident management and operational excellence practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Banking or Financial Services experience.
Experience with Enterprise Observability platforms.
Knowledge of SRE, AIOps, and IT Service Management (ITSM) environments.
Experience building AI solutions for operational intelligence or production support organizations.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

You wont be writing microservices in a vacuum. Your APIs feed mobile apps, web interfaces, and integrations. Your database decisions matter. Your deployments get reviewed. Your code runs in production, and youre the one who fixes it when it breaks.

Frontend work exists, but youre being hired because the backend is the constraint. Frontend will evolve. The API is permanent.

What You Will Do
Design and build REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
Write efficient SQL queries, optimise indexes, and manage relational databases under load.
Implement secure authentication, authorisation, and role-based access control.
Deploy backend services using Docker and containerised workflows.
Build CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
Debug production issues and ship fixes with minimal ceremony.
Collaborate closely with frontend teams on API contracts and data flow.
Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews.

1+ years of production experience with Python and Django - non-negotiable.

Strong SQL fundamentals: write efficient queries, understand indexes, optimise slow queries.
Direct experience deploying production code and debugging issues in production.
Git workflow and ability to write clean, reviewable code.

PostgreSQL experience (we use Postgres, not MySQL).

Previous work on multi-user or multi-tenant systems.

GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipeline experience.

Python (3.8+) with Django and Django REST Framework.
PostgreSQL as the primary database, Redis for caching and task queues.

Your code runs in production, not in staging. The APIs you build power healthcare applications, manufacturing workflows, and enterprise platforms - real users, real uptime requirements, real stakes.
